narrative.scqa_md:
Synchrony Financial is a $104.7B in assets regional bank regulated by Federal Reserve System (FRS) with 20,000 employees. A 5.8% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as stable give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-014, E-047]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.4/5. The deepest capability gap is Employee Experience Enablement at 2.1/5 against a 3.5 peer median [E-089, E-012].

Next is Resilience Reporting at 2.1/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-035, E-100]. Third is AI Fairness & Explainability (XAI) at 2.1/5 against a 3.2 peer median [E-018, E-019]. The issue register adds No T4 internal evidence in PUBLIC mode. The question for Synchrony Financial is whether to close Employee Experience Enablement first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost.

Synchrony Financial should lead with nCino (70/100 fit) against Financial Hardship Proactive Outreach, then sequence Salesforce behind it. Closing Employee Experience Enablement to the peer median alone is worth 1.4 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. The analyst's own priority framing: "CDO-Led Data Governance — Justin Heller (SVP, ~decade), VP Data Governance, 2 data patents [E-{CDO}] — level 3-level 4 data governance maturity — sophisticated buyer…".
